reasoning: Review is predominantly negative with mixed elements. While praising individual performances (Benanti, LuPone) and visual design, it criticizes fundamental aspects: weak character development, poor musical numbers, ill-conceived roles, and concludes audiences will feel 'shortchanged.' The opening description as 'resistible confection' and 'sporadically tickling' sets a dismissive tone that persists throughout.
